tasks.gr12-measurement-conversions-time-t1: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 1 — Measurement: Conversions and Time. Ask learners to convert fluently between metric units, interpret 12-hour and 24-hour time, calculate elapsed time from timetables and schedules, use compound units such as km/h, and judge whether a practical answer is reasonable in South African everyday contexts.
tasks.gr12-finance-documents-tariffs-t1: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 1 — Finance: Documents and Tariffs. Ask learners to read payslips, invoices, receipts and bank statements; calculate VAT; interpret fixed and variable charges; compare tariff options; and justify the cheapest or best-value choice in realistic South African contexts.
tasks.gr12-finance-budgets-pricing-break-even-: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 1 — Finance: Budgets, Pricing and Break-even. Ask learners to work with income-and-expenditure budgets, calculate markup, profit, loss and selling price, determine break-even points, and explain financial decisions using practical business or household scenarios.
tasks.gr12-data-handling-t1: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 1 — Data Handling. Ask learners to read and compare tables and graphs, calculate mean, median, mode, range and percentages, critique misleading data displays, and draw evidence-based conclusions from realistic social or financial data.
